Captured schema-only fixtures for the native1283531-schema-v1 compatibility tests.
The source was the independently extracted native 1283531 client/server reflection.
No resource documents, game assets, settings, saves or credentials are included.

Only relevant native types and their layout/default metadata are retained. Opaque
GUID-reference targets outside the serialized closure use named zero-field stubs;
their target layout is never traversed or admitted as a modified document type.
Type indexes are remapped, which also checks that indexes are not build identity.

Client: 2821 required types plus 124 opaque target names; 343783 gzip bytes.
Server: 2447 required types plus 104 opaque target names; 251457 gzip bytes.

The tests change widths, offsets, references, enum mappings, defaults, identities
and nested document types independently. An unchanged future build label, index
reordering and an unrelated new native type remain valid.
